title: CYBRIK org_membership v1 (D-2)
description: Binds an actor (ADR-0006 common-defs.actor) to an INTERNAL org_node with a role that maps to a capability archetype (ADR-0007 D-2; 02 §1.3). Membership confers node-scoped capability ONLY; it does NOT by itself confer descendant raw-data access (that is a separate scope grant + need-to-know, INV-1). An external authority (A05) is NEVER an org_node member (INV-2/OD-1): node_boundary_kind is const 'internal', so an external-boundary membership is structurally impossible. $id uses the RFC 2606 .example documentation domain. Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA). Accepted at Gate W2-G (Codex under Founder delegation, 2026-07-24).

membership_id.description: Opaque membership id. Revocation targets this id.

actor.description: The member. tenant_id is required here (cross-tenant authorization site). Model output can never populate an actor (ADR-0006).

org_node_id.description: The node the actor is a member of.

node_boundary_kind.description: The boundary of the bound node. Const 'internal': membership is only to an internal governed node. An external (A05) peer is an exchange peer, never a member (INV-2/OD-1) — an 'external' value is not expressible.

tenant_id.description: The node's tenant. MUST equal actor.tenant_id and the node's tenant_binding (runtime cross-tenant guard; OD-1).

confers_descendant_raw.description: Const false: membership NEVER confers descendant raw-data access by itself. Raw descendant access requires a separate explicit scope grant + need-to-know (INV-1; 02 §1.3, §2.5).

temporal.description: Membership is expiring and revocable like any grant (02 §5.4).
